subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Tetracarbonylcobaltate（[Co(CO)₄]⁻）？
A. Tetrahedral
B. Square planar
C. Square pyramidal
D. Trigonal prismatic
explanation: Tetrahedral. Covalent count: Co (group 9) 9 e; 4 × CO (L) 8 e; the 1− charge adds 1 e: 18 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry no charge and the complex has a 1− charge, so the metal is Co(−I), d¹⁰; d¹⁰ + 8 e from the ligands = 18 e. The negative charge adds one electron in the neutral count.
